scope.note: apps/web is outside the coverage scope by decision (D-16). kms, tenant-context and contacts-core have no tests of their own but appear here because apps/api and apps/worker execute them — a per-workspace report merge would show them at 0% and drag this number down to something meaningless.

note: lines is an UNROUNDED fraction, never a percentage: 08-14 compares covered/total against it directly, so a run at 84.996% must fail an 85% threshold rather than round up. The enforced value is deliberately ~1pp ABOVE the measurement, so the gate is RED until 08-16 adds targeted tests to packages/kms and packages/tenant-context. That is the intended sequence — do not lower this number to make the gate pass.
